# `gateway` — `/api/gateway`

/api/gateway — the headless gateway's HTTP + WebSocket surface (backend/gateway/).

Mounted only with the gateway daemon (`python -m backend.gateway`) or `ARYNWOOD_ENABLE_GATEWAY=1`.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/gateway/approvals`](#get-api-gateway-approvals) | Destructive or publishing tool calls waiting for a decision. |
| POST | [`/api/gateway/approvals/{request_id}`](#post-api-gateway-approvals-request-id) | Approve or deny one waiting tool call. |
| POST | [`/api/gateway/inbound`](#post-api-gateway-inbound) | Run one turn for a session, creating it on first contact. |
| GET | [`/api/gateway/memory`](#get-api-gateway-memory) | Read-only. |
| GET | [`/api/gateway/sessions`](#get-api-gateway-sessions) | Every session, most recently active first. |
| GET | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}`](#get-api-gateway-sessions-key) | One session. |
| PUT | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}`](#put-api-gateway-sessions-key) | Create a session, or change its persona, model, server, project, label or trust level. |
| DELETE | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}`](#delete-api-gateway-sessions-key) | Forget the session; its conversation stays in the history. |
| POST | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}/cancel`](#post-api-gateway-sessions-key-cancel) | Stop the session's turn in progress, if any. |
| GET | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}/messages`](#get-api-gateway-sessions-key-messages) | The newest messages of the session's current conversation (limit 1-500), oldest first. |
| POST | [`/api/gateway/sessions/{key}/reset`](#post-api-gateway-sessions-key-reset) | Continue in a new conversation from the next message. |
| GET | [`/api/gateway/status`](#get-api-gateway-status) | Whether this is the daemon, how many sessions exist, and what is running, queued and waiting for approval. |
| WS | [`/api/gateway/ws`](#ws-api-gateway-ws) | Follow sessions' events, send messages, answer approvals and cancel turns (protocol: docs/api/README.md). |

<a id="get-api-gateway-approvals"></a>
### `GET /api/gateway/approvals`

Destructive or publishing tool calls waiting for a decision.

- Handler: [`list_approvals`](../../../backend/routers/gateway.py)
- Mounted only with the gateway daemon (`python -m backend.gateway`) or `ARYNWOOD_ENABLE_GATEWAY=1`
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list, each item `p.public()` (returned as is; see the handler)

<a id="post-api-gateway-inbound"></a>
### `POST /api/gateway/inbound`

Run one turn for a session, creating it on first contact. With wait=false, answers at once and the result arrives as a turn_result event.

- Handler: [`inbound`](../../../backend/routers/gateway.py)
- Mounted only with the gateway daemon (`python -m backend.gateway`) or `ARYNWOOD_ENABLE_GATEWAY=1`
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `InboundRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session` | string | yes |  |  |
| `text` | string | yes |  |  |
| `sender` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `source` | string | no | `"api"` |  |
| `label` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `approvals` | one of `"deny"`, `"wait"` | no | `"deny"` |  |
| `trust_level` | one of `"owner"`, `"known"`, `"stranger"` or null | no |  |  |
| `wait` | boolean | no | `true` |  |
| `persona` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `model` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `server_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `project_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `accepted`, `session`
- `200`: JSON object with `session`, `conversation_id`, `run_id`, `status`, `reply`, `trust_level`, `error`, `evidence`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | the underlying error's message | `inbound` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 429 | the underlying error's message | `inbound` |
